# Bootstrap 5.3.3

Vendored, unchanged, from the npm package `bootstrap@5.3.3`
(`dist/css/bootstrap.min.css`, `dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js`,
`LICENSE`), so that the web UI needs no CDN and works offline.

SHA-384 (the integrity values that Bootstrap publishes):

* `bootstrap.min.css`: `QWTKZyjpPEjISv5WaRU9OFeRpok6YctnYmDr5pNlyT2bRjXh0JMhjY6hW+ALEwIH`
* `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`: `YvpcrYf0tY3lHB60NNkmXc5s9fDVZLESaAA55NDzOxhy9GkcIdslK1eN7N6jIeHz`

`test_mast_web_ui.py` checks these hashes.
